ad02c85f8fca1571a0a40b37f9663867.overview: Two melancholic Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious underworld figure, the other with a beautiful and ethereal server at a late-night restaurant.
ad02c85f8fca1571a0a40b37f9663867.tagline: If my memory of her has an expiration date, let it be 10,000 years...

ad04cec3f4c0ab83cb6ebcdf5e2ee5e4.overview: After graduating from film school, Aura returns to New York to live with her photographer mother, Siri, and her sister, Nadine, who has just finished high school. Aura is directionless and wonders where to go next in her career and her life. She takes a job in a restaurant and tries unsuccessfully to develop relationships with men, including Keith, a chef where she works, and cult Internet star Jed.
ad04cec3f4c0ab83cb6ebcdf5e2ee5e4.tagline: Aura would like you to know that she is having a very, very hard time.

ad1b9abceadf798a7bde54b003d11150.overview: An aging screen icon gets lured into accepting an award at a rinky-dink film festival in Nashville, Tenn., sending him on a hilarious fish-out-of-water adventure and an unexpectedly poignant journey into his past.
ad1b9abceadf798a7bde54b003d11150.tagline: The best is yet to come.

ad39d85e243cad6be0ef88a58f0f414f.overview: Bud Baxter is a minor clerk in a huge New York insurance company, until he discovers a quick way to climb the corporate ladder. He lends out his apartment to the executives as a place to take their mistresses. Although he often has to deal with the aftermath of their visits, one night he's left with a major problem to solve.
ad39d85e243cad6be0ef88a58f0f414f.tagline: Movie-wise, there has never been anything like it - laugh-wise, love-wise, or otherwise-wise!

ad4dc2449bf2f4c0f8120c40c73f0f16.overview: Friends Jake and Jack Bull join up with Civil War guerrilla fighters, yet after the realities of war set in, they must decide what honor truly means.
ad4dc2449bf2f4c0f8120c40c73f0f16.tagline: In a No-man's Land between North and South, You didn't fight for the Blue or the Grey... You fought for your friends and family.

ad6008c0e8043d37518e8f81cd4d0091.overview: A Black hitman who models after the samurai of old finds himself targeted for death by the mob.
ad6008c0e8043d37518e8f81cd4d0091.tagline: Live by the code. Die by the code.

directors: Nelson Carlos de los Santos Arias
ad70731a0c477cfa40526ce5869e056f.overview: A voice  that claims to be from a hippopotamus. A voice that doesn’t understand the perception of time. Pepe, the first and last hippo killed in the Americas, tells his story with the overwhelming orality of these towns.

adb0e7f27c09e8c6c226fa60bab1772a.overview: Each member of a family in Taipei asks hard questions about life's meaning as they live through everyday quandaries. NJ is morose: his brother owes him money, his mother is in a coma, his wife suffers a spiritual crisis when she finds her life a blank and his business partners make bad decisions.
adb0e7f27c09e8c6c226fa60bab1772a.tagline: We never live the same day twice.

adb34b092c9e19e91aec43716c68a647.overview: An office clerk loves entering contests in the hopes of someday winning a fortune and marrying the girl he loves. His latest attempt is the Maxford House Coffee Slogan Contest. As a joke, some of his co-workers put together a fake telegram which says that he won the $25,000 grand prize.
adb34b092c9e19e91aec43716c68a647.tagline: If you can't sleep at night, it isn't the coffee - it's the bunk!

adb50f13fffa560adb6cbd9967edcc41.overview: A mysterious woman on the run, and the resourceful fixer assigned to bring her in. Their two unique stories inextricably link, as the stakes of the pursuit rise to apocalyptic proportions.

adf0664c085cdad9c71176cd51424a2a.overview: A prudish married couple feel put upon by the swingers living in their apartment building. One night, by accident, they discover a way to both rid themselves of the “perverts” down the hall and simultaneously realize their dream of opening a restaurant.
adf0664c085cdad9c71176cd51424a2a.tagline: A tasty comedy of bad manners.
